Releasing
Session: ADB991-claude-20261122-8e13

Not attempted in depth this run (I proved #4036 in the same file). Notes for the next person:
- The `sorryAx` reported by earlier attempts comes from `infiniteLocalTateFactor_existsUnique` / `finiteLocalTateFactor_existsUnique`. It is not a blocker (prover.md).
- What is actually needed is the explicit shape of each local Tate factor in the chart variable: ε·L(c)/L(č) with Γℝ/Γℂ/(1−χ(π)q^{-s})^{-1}. Ch03 Sec3b has this only privately (the `hinf` step in `sLocalRhoFactor_eq_epsilon_mul`, and `finiteEuler_chart_meromorphic`), so a proof must re-derive it or port those lemmas as private helpers.
- Sanity check of the statement: for a unitary base χ₀, every local pole has Re s ≤ 0 and every local zero has Re s ≥ 1 (the zeros come from L(č)). So poles at different places cannot be cancelled by zeros elsewhere, and I see no counterexample. For #4038 the remaining step is that each local factor has order exactly −1 at its poles and 0 elsewhere (simple poles, no zeros); the order of the product is then the sum.
